tables.name: nc_users
tables.purpose: List of people who can sign in to n8n Connect. Without an enabled row, the server rejects the account.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email of the Firebase account. Lookup key.

columns.name: enabled
columns.description: If false, the person cannot sign in.

tables.name: nc_devices
tables.purpose: Android devices with an open session. Stores the FCM token used to send pushes.

columns.name: device_id
columns.description: Random device identifier generated by the app.

columns.name: fcm_token
columns.description: FCM target token for pushes. Empty after signing out.

columns.name: last_seen
columns.description: Last time the device renewed its session.

tables.name: nc_apps
tables.purpose: Catalog of apps that n8n Connect shows on the phone.

columns.name: app_id
columns.description: App identifier. Appears as id in the catalog.

columns.name: icon
columns.description: Icon name from the app's icon table.

columns.name: path
columns.description: Path of the webhook that returns the spec, e.g. n8n-connect/apps/tools.

columns.name: enabled
columns.description: Only enabled apps appear in the catalog.

columns.name: allowed_emails
columns.description: Comma-separated emails. Empty means all enabled users.

tables.name: nc_inbox
tables.purpose: Texts and links sent from other apps using the Share option. One row per submission.

columns.name: subject
columns.description: Subject from the source app. Empty if it had none.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Note written in the app. Empty if none was written.

nc_apps.name: Tools
nc_apps.description: Alarm, live panel, form and phone actions
